"""L10M-ORACLE-3 conservative closed-loop navigation policy."""


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Use safety-first target validation, held scan sweeps, and hysteretic steering."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    scan_hold = int(memory.get("scan_hold", 0))

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading_error = float(observation["heading_error"])

    # Safety is an unconditional hard gate.
    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        memory["scan_hold"] = 0
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    target_locked = (
        visible
        and target_confidence >= 0.55
        and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    )

    if not target_locked:
        memory["scan_hold"] = 0
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps > 0:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory

        if scan_hold <= 0:
            scan_direction = (
                "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
            )
            scan_hold = 2
        scan_hold -= 1
        memory["scan_direction"] = scan_direction
        memory["scan_hold"] = scan_hold
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        return scan_direction, 0.74, memory

    memory["scan_hold"] = 0

    # Confirm a newly acquired track before committing to motion.
    if track_age < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"

    if distance == "near":
        if abs(heading_error) <= 15.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.80:
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory

        steer_error = bearing if abs(bearing) > 3.0 else heading_error
        memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
        return ("VEER_LEFT" if steer_error < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"), 0.88, memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"

    # Keep small bearing errors on the shortest, centered path.
    if abs(bearing) <= 18.0 and observation["corridor_center"]:
        return "FORWARD", 0.91, memory

    if bearing < -18.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.90, memory
    if bearing > 18.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.90, memory

    # If the preferred side is unavailable, use any confirmed safe corridor.
    if observation["corridor_center"]:
        return "FORWARD", 0.86, memory
    if bearing < 0.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.83, memory
    if bearing > 0.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.83, memory
    if observation["corridor_left"]:
        return "VEER_LEFT", 0.80, memory
    if observation["corridor_right"]:
        return "VEER_RIGHT", 0.80, memory

    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    return "STOP", 0.98, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
